Asset type: one static full-body left-facing character candidate for Resident Evil Combat.
Input image 1 is the exact documentary identity reference for the specified game and edition. Create a new independent pose facing SCREEN LEFT, not a horizontally mirrored copy. Keep the entire silhouette and every represented extremity inside the canvas, including wing tips, antennae, tail, fingers and toes where applicable, with generous clear margins of roughly seven percent. Subject: Chainsaw Sisters from Resident Evil 4 REMAKE (2023): create ONLY the foreground individual in the attached two-person source. The selected individual wears the LIGHT / CREAM short-sleeve full-length pleated dress, has the reference's bandaged head with visible eye/hair, pale gray forearms, and holds ONE red chainsaw in both hands. Preserve her exact light dress, sleeve lengths, waist, long pleated hem, complete shoes, bandage arrangement and the reference's chainsaw proportions. Do not include the second background sister, her long cardigan or dark green skirt; do not combine their costumes and do not invent a personal name. One single woman and one single chainsaw in a neutral full-body pose coherently facing LEFT, including head, torso, hips and both shoes. The chainsaw blade points left/downward and remains entirely inside the canvas, with both hands naturally holding its handles; no cutting action, contact, victim, motion effects or added injury detail. Keep crown, complete blade tip, long hem and both shoes within generous transparent margins. Full-body portrait, enough horizontal room for the complete saw.
